verdict.rationale: Sardine documents a no-code rule editor that runs ingested transaction data to flag anomalous behavior, and a rule engine for creating rules, so compliance officers can configure transaction monitoring rules. There is no evidence of segment-specific thresholds; the only threshold control shown is fuzzy-match tuning for screening, which is a different feature. Missing for 10: segment- or cohort-specific threshold configuration, detail on rule-editor capabilities for transaction monitoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.
